انتقدا (form VIII)

# اُنْتُقِدَا (untuqidā) /un.tu.qi.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# اِنْتَقِدَا (intaqidā) /in.ta.qi.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
